summary: Backend testing for Law/Guard/Jail overhaul (iteration 17). All 12 new unit tests in test_law_jail_overhaul.py pass. All 11 pre-existing T1 guard tests still pass. Live-API smoke (5 tests) confirms /api/bounty-board, /api/locations/{nation}, surrender-requires-auth, and that _auto_arrest_and_imprison helper is importable from server. No regressions in test_law_refactor.py (9/9). Auto-arrest AI-gated path not exercised end-to-end (requires live LLM to set arrest_executed=true); helper existence + route wiring verified by code review.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/law.py surrender flow correctly delegates to jail_service.ensure_jail_for_city() and resolve_city_for_location() — jail_slug is derived from the city, never from the player's current scene. Good.

Jail-resolution failure path in routes/law.py:136-138 falls back to trial.get('jail_location') or original location — defensive but means a partial failure could still lock the player in a non-jail. Currently best-effort and logged; acceptable.

_auto_arrest_and_imprison() seeds a 'resisting_authority' minor crime when AI flags arrest with a clean record — this is a sensible design choice and matches the PHYSICAL-TOUCH rule in the prompt block.
LawService.format_record_for_prompt() now embeds PHYSICAL-TOUCH and HOSTILE FIRST-STRIKE rules even for clean characters — verified by unit tests.
WARRANT_TRIGGER_SEVERITIES includes 'minor' and 'major' but excludes 'petty' (which uses PETTY_WARRANT_COUNT count-based threshold). Behaviour matches spec.

AI-gated path (arrest_executed=true → _auto_arrest_and_imprison → auto_arrest payload in RP response) was NOT exercised end-to-end as it requires a live LLM call. Helper existence + import + route call-site verified.
